The comment must state the resulting evaluator outcome and stable reason when no opt-in is authorized.

NOT IN SCOPE: implementing the resolver or policy.validate integration (owned by task-064b97584aff4e07967738f79134a723); changing packages/core policy language; weakening BUDGET_RESERVATION_POLICY_NOT_ALLOWED; using demo/fixture literals, caller facts, or a default R0/R1 as authority.

definitionOfDone: The durable decision comment names one exact existing record plus its real non-test production writer and strict current reader, the project/attempt/action join keys, and why that record is entitled to classify Foundation policy risk; a demo literal, fixture, caller payload, uncalled writer, or symbol-only export does not pass.

The comment names the exact factId, derives rather than defaults its PolicyRiskTier, names the truthClass basis, and states stable missing/unreadable/stale/foreign behavior. It explicitly rejects authorized-empty facts because evaluatePolicy would return RISK_TIER_UNCLASSIFIABLE / HOLD_UNKNOWN.

For every affected Foundation action, the comment explicitly chooses an autoApprovalOptIns entry and tier ceiling or explicitly chooses no opt-in. It states that tier and opt-in are separate, and that no opt-in yields AUTO_APPROVAL_NOT_OPTED_IN / REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL and remains inadmissible downstream.

The waiver decision names the real durable human-approval record/reader that can back humanApprovalRef and its scope/expiry/SOFT validation, or explicitly rules that the source returns resolved-empty waivers. No fabricated approval reference or waiver-based lift of HOLD_UNKNOWN is permitted.

The comment is explicitly human-confirmed, records task-064b97584aff4e07967738f79134a723 as the implementation consumer and task-eb6a1fa6 as downstream, includes the exact verification command/output over the delivered tree, and makes no source-code changes.
taskRails: This row decides product authority; an architect or worker may measure and present options but may not choose the record, fact, tier, or opt-ins for the human.
A tier is classification, not unattended-execution authority. autoApprovalOptIns is a separate explicit choice and must be recorded action by action.
Missing or unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN. No demo, fixture, caller input, arbitrary constant, or merely persisted caller value can become the selected authority.
The decision must survive on a durable Moe task comment; complete_task or QA summary fields are not durable evidence surfaces.
